You have received an encryption key exchange request from

TERMS OF USE 
 
1. FUNCTIONAL FEATURES 
1.1. This feature provides encryption of message text only, attachment protection is not implemented. 
1.2. This feature is not available for group chats or conversations with groups. 
1.3. To start exchanging encrypted messages, participants must complete a key exchange procedure. 
1.4. Messages can only be decrypted on the device that participated in the specific key pair exchange. On other devices, in other applications, or in a browser, the user will not be able to read the original message content. 
 
2. KEY EXCHANGE 
2.1. To transfer keys, the application will send several system messages directly into the conversation. 
2.2. Compromise of system messages does not pose a security risk, they serve only as transport and do not contain encryption keys in plaintext. 
2.3. Deleting system messages from the conversation does not affect encryption functionality. 
2.4. Key exchange can be performed repeatedly an unlimited number of times. New messages will be encrypted with new keys, while old messages can still be decrypted with previous keys. 
 
3. KEY STORAGE 
3.1. Encryption keys are stored locally on users devices in persistent or volatile memory (depending on the chosen mode). 
3.2. If encryption keys are lost, the user will not be able to read encrypted incoming or outgoing messages. 
3.3. The user may lose encryption keys in the following cases: 
- uninstalling the application from the device; 
- clearing application data; 
- using the “Delete keys” option in the application settings; 
- closing the application (only in volatile key storage mode); 
- removing the account from the application. 
 
4. DISCLAIMER 
4.1. The developers of the Fenrir application are not responsible for any data loss resulting from loss of encryption keys or improper use of this feature.
Encryption keys will be stored in volatile memory. IMPORTANT: After closing the application, these keys will be permanently lost and you will not be able to decrypt incoming or outgoing messages.
